baseline_checkpoint: checkpoints/baseline/iter_3 (locally trained; not shipped in the repo -- see 'What Was Deliberately Left Out of Scope')
note: Both runs were executed end-to-end in this repository's CI-friendly footprint (2 CPUs, 1 rollout worker, train_batch_size=2000, 3 iterations each) as a correctness/integration demonstration, not a converged benchmark -- see the 'Not a converged policy' scope note in the README. The fine-tuning run's reward is noisy over only 3 iterations (as expected for PPO on a freshly-shifted distribution) and is not yet expected to exceed the baseline's -- what this demonstrates is that weight transfer + continued training onto a harder, genuinely different demand distribution runs correctly end-to-end, not that 3 iterations is enough to fully re-converge.
